==Description==
'''A-60ii''' is one of the many ii variants in '''Rooms: Found Footage: RENOVATED''', more info shown below

==Behavior==
Once [[A-60i]] hits the door, '''A-60ii''' will have a chance to spawn, if it does spawn, it will rush to the main room without any warning at EXTREMELY fast speeds, breaking the door and deleting any lockers in the main room if there was a player hiding inside.

==Strategies & Tips==
After [[A-60i]] attacks, hide quickly, as '''A-60ii''' gives no visual cues and almost no time to hide. Remain hidden for as long as possible after [[A-60i]] passes so you don't get killed by its lethal snipe.

==Trivia==
* '''A-60ii''' can chain just like [[A-60i]] and [[D-35i]].
* '''A-60ii''' used to be an admin only entity. However, when [[Modifiers|II hate this]] was added he was implemented as a normal entity in the Executive Update
** This is the same case for [[D-55ii]] and [[D-60ii]]. They used to be admin only entities but they were introduced as normal entities when the modifier [[Modifiers|II hate this]]  was added
